fields.note: Zoho Recruit City facet; the widget filters the single loaded response in the browser.

fields.label: Remote Job
fields.note: Remote_Job boolean facet in the widget info block; no enumerated option list is published.

notes: The ledger URL /careers/ returns 404; the live official entry is yellow.ai/career/, which embeds a Zoho Recruit careers site at careers.yellow.ai. That widget calls GET https://careers.yellow.ai/recruit/v2/public/Job_Openings?pagename=Careers&source=CareerSite and renders the returned rows; at observation it returned one row (GTM recruiter, position filled). The response info block exposes facets Remote_Job, Job_Type, Industry, City and Country, and the widget's search and facet controls filter that already-loaded response client-side. The endpoint rejects extra page/filter parameters, so native_query is false.
